summary: Develop practical hotel housekeeping, F&B service, HACCP, and catering coordination skills. Explore the five-day course and curriculum.
lede: Hotel housekeeping and food and beverage operations training covers room readiness, food hygiene, and coordinated guest service. It is for frontline hotel staff and supervisors responsible for rooms, restaurant service, and catering. Learners practise cleaning and inspection checklists, room-status handovers, HACCP-based food-safety monitoring, POS order checks, and function setup records.
audienceIntro: This hotel operations training is designed for frontline hotel staff and supervisors who coordinate room readiness, guest service, food hygiene, and catering delivery.
modules: Restaurant Mise en Place and Service
prerequisites: Recommended: basic familiarity with hotel operations or frontline hospitality work. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop if you want to practise the spreadsheet-based tracking exercise; no specialist software installation is required.
